text: You will, in time, discover most of them to have been erroneous; and, if you follow them long, you will perceive your error too late; but if you will be led by a guide, who, you are sure, does not mean to mislead you, you will unite two things, seldom united, in the same person; the vivacity and spirit of youth, with the caution and experience of age.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CC, to his son, London, March 26, 1754
